Blast Fishing 1.2.0
English · 中文说明见下半页

Buy a Water Mine from Willy for 250g, walk to the end of the pier, and toss it into the sea. A water column erupts at the impact point, fish fly out of the spray, and the rest of the catch rains down around your farmer. Cherry Bombs, Bombs, and Mega Bombs work too. Each has its own plume size, and the spray takes its color from the water where it lands.

What can you catch?

The blast uses the fishing rules for the tile it hits. Season, time of day, weather, fishing level, and catch history all matter where the game checks them. Try the beach on a sunny summer afternoon for Pufferfish. Return to the same spot at night and the catch changes. Fish ponds and tiles where fishing is prohibited produce no wild catch.

Fish, trash, and other water items are all enabled on a fresh install. Sea Jelly, River Jelly, and Cave Jelly share the “Allow other items” setting with seaweed and algae. Each jelly can turn up in its usual waters. If you’re upgrading from 1.1.0 and want jellies, check that “Allow other items” is on.

A blast can drop up to 10 items by default, counting the water burst and the fish rain together. Turning off a category can leave you with fewer items. You can set the limit anywhere from 0 to 500. Legendary fish and one-time quest finds go straight to your inventory. If your bag is full, check the lost and found in Mayor Lewis’s house.

Aim and throw

• Mouse and keyboard — Select a Water Mine or bomb, point at water, then left-click or press G.
• Controller — Aim with the right stick and press your Use Tool button.
• Android touch — Press on water, drag to aim, and release to throw. Release over land or the toolbar to cancel.

The guide follows the arc from the bomb above your farmer’s head to the landing ring. It stays visible while the previous splash is still on screen. Under Controls → Throw guide, choose classic faint dots (default), outlined dashes, an outlined solid line, or just the ring. Standard bombs keep their normal placement behavior on land. Over water, the landing ring replaces the red placement square.

Settings worth knowing

• Prefer all your catches to burst out of the water? Turn off “Sky-fall delivery”.
• Want to fish outside the usual seasons or hours? Enable “Use magic bait rules”. “Legendary fish anywhere” is a separate option. Both start off.
• Blast rain waters tilled soil in the current location and on your farm by default, even when you throw from the beach. You can turn watering off on its own.
• The default limit is one legendary fish per blast. You can also adjust fish quality, Fishing XP, and effect intensity.

Installation

Install SMAPI for Stardew Valley 1.6, unzip the download, and place the BlastFishing folder in Mods. Launch through SMAPI. When upgrading, replace the old mod files in the same folder to keep your config.json. Only one copy of Blast Fishing should be in Mods. Generic Mod Config Menu is optional and lets you change settings in-game.

Tested on Windows with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.2. Android touch controls are included for compatible community SMAPI builds. Testing on a physical Android device is still pending.


中文说明 · 炸鱼 1.2.0

去威利的鱼店花 250 金买一枚炸鱼水雷，走到码头边，把它扔进海里。炸点会腾起一道水柱，一部分渔获随水花飞出，其余像下雨一样落到农夫身边。背包里已有的樱桃炸弹、炸弹和超级炸弹也能用。不同炸弹激起的水柱高低各异，水花会随落点的水色变化。

能炸到什么？

看炸弹落在哪里，也看你什么时候来。游戏会按这格水面的钓鱼规则判断季节、时段、天气、钓鱼等级和捕获记录。例如，夏季晴天下午在海边有机会炸到河豚，晚上再来，同一个落点就会换一批鱼。农场鱼塘和禁止钓鱼的水格只会溅起水花。

新安装默认允许鱼、垃圾和其他水产。海凝胶、河凝胶和洞穴凝胶与海草、藻类共用「允许其他物品」，在各自原本能钓到的水域才有机会出现。如果你从 1.1.0 升级，想炸凝胶，可以先看看这项有没有打开。

「每次爆炸最多掉几件」默认是 10，水面炸出和从天上落下的渔获合在一起算。关掉某类物品后，实际数量可能更少，上限可以在 0 到 500 之间调节。鱼王和一次性任务物品会优先放进背包。如果背包满了，可以去镇长刘易斯家里的失物招领箱领取。

怎么瞄准和投掷

• 鼠标和键盘 — 选中水雷或炸弹，把鼠标指向水面，左键点击或按 G 投掷。
• 手柄 — 用右摇杆瞄准，按游戏绑定的「使用工具」键投掷。
• 安卓触屏 — 从水面按下，拖动选点，松手投出。拖回陆地或工具栏再松手即可取消。

引导线从农夫头顶举着的炸弹延伸到落点环。上一枚炸弹的水柱还没散，也可以继续瞄准。在「控制 → 投掷引导线」里可以选择经典淡点（默认）、描边虚线、描边实线或仅落点环。普通炸弹照常在陆地放置，瞄准水面时会用落点环取代原版红框。

几个常用设置

• 想让所有渔获都从水里炸出来，可以关闭「天空掉落演出」。
• 想放宽季节、时间和天气限制，可以打开「使用魔法鱼饵规则」。「任何地方都有鱼王」另有开关，两项默认都关闭。
• 暴雨默认会浇湿当前地点和主农场的耕地，在海边炸鱼也会给农场浇水。只想炸鱼时，可以单独关掉浇地。
• 每次爆炸默认最多出一条鱼王。鱼的品质、钓鱼经验和特效强度也可以调整。

安装与升级

安装适配《星露谷物语》1.6 的 SMAPI，解压下载包，把 BlastFishing 文件夹放进 Mods，再通过 SMAPI 启动游戏。升级时，将新版文件覆盖到原模组文件夹，保留原有的 config.json，并确保 Mods 中只装一份炸鱼模组。想在游戏中直接改设置，可以选装 Generic Mod Config Menu。

Windows 已在游戏 1.6.15 和 SMAPI 4.5.2 上实测。安卓提供触屏操作，需要匹配游戏版本的社区 SMAPI，尚未做安卓真机验证。
